 In his first media appearance since joining the New York Knicks, Knecht officially addressed this Lakers exit after two disappointing seasons.
 "I don't think nothing's changed. I think it's just the team got changed and that was it," Knecht told reporters Sunday when asked what happened to his Lakers tenure that led to his leaving.
 "Still loved it when my time was there and I have no hard feelings, but on to better things."
 Dalton Knecht parted ways with Lakers after two seasons of ups and downs
 Dalton Knecht was waived by the Los Angeles Lakers last Monday to meet the NBA's required 15-man lineup heading into the new season.
 Selected 17th overall in the 2024 NBA Draft, Dalton Knecht arrived in Los Angeles with considerable expectations after showcasing his scoring ability and red-hot shooting early on. His strong start generated plenty of buzz among Lakers fans, but his rookie campaign took a turn midway through the season as his production dipped. His situation became more complicated after he was involved in the Lakers’ unsuccessful trade for Mark Williams.
 Knecht finished his first NBA season averaging 9.1 points in 19.2 minutes per game across 78 appearances, including 16 starts. However, his playing time and role took a significant hit the following season. He gradually fell out of head coach JJ Redick’s rotation, leaving him with limited opportunities to make an impact.
 In 54 appearances last season, Knecht averaged just 4.2 points in 10.2 minutes per game, enduring noise and trade chatter all year long.
 Dalton Knecht explains why he joined Knicks
 Now in a new chapter with the reigning NBA champions, Dalton Knecht couldn't be more excited to be a member of the New York Knicks.
 Knecht joined the Knicks via a two-way deal and is expected to get more opportunities under the team's G League development program.
 “It just felt like the best opportunity,” Knecht said about joining Knicks despite receiving reported interests elsewhere. “I talked to the coaching staff, known them for awhile, so it was good. Thought this would be a great fit, and I’m excited to be here.”
